report.detail: The first pass recorded the symptom; this pass found the cause and verified it against the live oracle rather than the clone. The repository ships Python source whose indentation is collapsed to one space per level: 35 of its 45 Python files raise SyntaxError under ast.parse, including src/aspose_tex/presentation/__init__.py - the module its own docstring calls the user-facing entry point, and the module that defines TeXJob, TeXOptions and the whole OutputDevice hierarchy. Confirmed by gh api repos/aspose-tex-foss/Aspose.TeX-FOSS-for-Python/contents/src/aspose_tex/presentation/__init__.py at the pinned revision: IndentationError at line 108, 'expected an indented block after function definition on line 107'. The library cannot be imported, which is why nine of ten examples were CONTRADICTED and why TeXJob never became a SUPPORTED fact. No other repository in this cohort has a single unparseable file (Words 218, PDF 133, Cells 109, HTML 104, BarCode 78, Font 72, Page 67, Note 14, Email 13 files, zero errors each). Per loop-prompt rule 16 the defect is recorded here and never inside a candidate; no fallback can compose a public API from source that does not parse.
